name: card_advisor_chat
description: When the user is shopping for a credit card and wants tailored advice (travel rewards vs cashback vs gas savings), this agent extracts their priority and returns a focused recommendation. Asks a clarifying question if the user hasn't stated a preference.
search_hint: credit card advice recommend travel cashback gas rewards which card best for me suggest

data.label: Extract interest
Ask what matters most
data.prompt_template: What matters most to you in a credit card — travel rewards, cashback, or gas savings?
data.voice_prompt_template: What matters most to you — travel rewards, cashback, or gas savings?

data.label: Look up travel-card details via knowledge_search
data.system_prompt: You are recommending a travel-rewards credit card. You MUST call `knowledge_search` to retrieve current details before recommending — do not answer from memory. Use a self-contained noun-phrase query such as 'travel rewards credit card features benefits annual fee points'.

data.label: Compose the travel-card recommendation
data.system_prompt: Using the knowledge_search results in the prior messages, recommend a travel-rewards card in 2–3 sentences. Cite specific card features only when they appear in the retrieved context — never invent details. If retrieval returned nothing relevant, say so honestly and suggest the user reach out to a card specialist.

data.label: Recommend cashback card
data.text_template: Recommend the Everyday Cash Rewards card. Key points: 1.5% cashback on every purchase, no annual fee, easy redemption to checking. Frame it as the right call for someone who wants simple, no-thinking-required rewards. Suggest they ask about other cards if they want a comparison.

data.label: Recommend gas card
data.text_template: Recommend the Fuel Saver Card. Key points: 5% back at gas stations, 3% back on EV charging, 1% on everything else, no annual fee. Frame it as ideal for daily drivers. Mention that someone spending $300/month on gas earns about $180/year back. Suggest they ask about other cards if they want a comparison.
